SendOnlyKeys.name: sendOnlyKeys
SendOnlyKeys.description: Uses only transaction keys and (delta) values for writing back data. If disabled, also includes metadata such as columns and rows. It is recommended to enable this and use transaction keys (guide available on knowledge base)

BatchChangesByRow.name: batchRows
BatchChangesByRow.description: Batches changes per row rather than per cell. Meaning all cell changes on the same row are inserted together in the database rather than one by one.

DoNotSaveZeroValues.name: excludeZeros
DoNotSaveZeroValues.description: Does not allow saving zero values to the database

AllowWritingInBlanks.name: writeBlanks
AllowWritingInBlanks.description: Allow writing in cells that have blank/null values

EnableDrillThrough.name: drillThrough
EnableDrillThrough.description: Drill through enables a transaction view when double clicking on a cell

BatchChanges.name: batchChanges
BatchChanges.description: If false, saves new cell values upon changing them

AutoSaveBatchChanges.name: autoSaveBatchChanges
AutoSaveBatchChanges.description: Enable auto-save if batch changes are on

AutoSaveBatchChangesInterval.name: autoSaveBatchChangesInterval
AutoSaveBatchChangesInterval.description: Time interval before a batch of value changes is automatically saved (in seconds)

DelayedProcessingData.name: delayedProcessingData
DelayedProcessingData.description: When enabled, you can type quickly without interruptions. Changes are queued and processed after a short delay, ensuring a smooth editing experience. This setting can NOT be enabled if Auto save batch changes is on

DelayedProcessingDataInterval.name: delayedProcessingDataInterval
DelayedProcessingDataInterval.description: Time interval before a batch of value changes is automatically updated (in seconds)

LockCellsWhileSaving.name: editLock
LockCellsWhileSaving.description: Disables modifying cell values while a writeback transaction is in progress

PendingChangeIndicator.name: dataPendingOnSave
PendingChangeIndicator.description: Indicates on save button if there is unsaved data in the visual. This is only a visual indicator and does not affect the writeback process

LicenseKey.name: key
LicenseKey.description: The accoPLANNNING license key (only for non-Appsource instances)

SelfHostedAPI.name: useOnPremAPI
SelfHostedAPI.description: Enable self-hosted API for writeback through your own API (see knowledge base)

SelfHostedAPIURL.name: onPremAPIURL
SelfHostedAPIURL.description: The URL of your self-hosted API (see knowledge base)

AuthenticationMethod.name: authenticationMethod
AuthenticationMethod.description: Choose database authentication method to use

UseFabricConnection.name: isFabric
UseFabricConnection.description: Toggle this on if you want to writeback to a Fabric Data Warehouse

ServerName.name: host
ServerName.description: The server hosting the writeback table

DatabaseUser.name: user
DatabaseUser.description: The database user credentials for table access

DatabasePassword.name: password
DatabasePassword.description: The database password/secret credentials for table access

TenantId.name: tenantId
TenantId.description: The Tenant Id for Service Principal authentication

DatabaseName.name: DB
DatabaseName.description: The name of the database for writeback

WritebackTable.name: writeBack
WritebackTable.description: The table to write back to

UsernameColumn.name: usernameColumn
UsernameColumn.description: The name of the column in the table that logs current user upon writeback

TimestampColumn.name: timestampColumn
TimestampColumn.description: The name of the column in the table that logs the current timestamp upon writeback

CurrentUser.name: currentUser
CurrentUser.description: The current user of the visual

RequestTimeoutSeconds.name: requestTimeout
RequestTimeoutSeconds.description: Time limit on how long a writeback transaction may take

ReferenceUser.name: referenceWritebackUser
ReferenceUser.description: A reference of the user last encrypted

GenerateWritebackTableTemplate.name: writebackTableAssist
GenerateWritebackTableTemplate.description: Displays an SQL script based on data fields, measures, and connection fields for generating a WB schema and table

TableStyle.name: layout
TableStyle.description: The general style of the table

DecimalAndThousandSeparators.name: separators
DecimalAndThousandSeparators.description: Decimal & thousand separators. Power BI default uses the language settings in Power BI to determine separators

AllowSortingOn.name: sorting
AllowSortingOn.description: Allows users to sort values on given dimensions. Sorting changes do not persist

AutoExpand.name: autoExpand
AutoExpand.description: Automatically expands and shows all children of the given type on start-up

AggregationLabels.name: aggregationLabels
AggregationLabels.description: Prepends aggregation labels on headers, e.g. 'sum of [My Measure]'

AllowFiltering.name: allowFiltering
AllowFiltering.description: Allowing user to filter based on clicked hierarchy

EnableHierarchy.name: useHierarchy
EnableHierarchy.description: Enables hierarchy on rows, for cases of unbalanced or ragged hierarchies

HideColumnHierarchyNames.name: hideColumnHierachyNames
HideColumnHierarchyNames.description: Visibly hides the column hierachy names

HideDimensionsWithBlankTitles.name: excludeBlanks
HideDimensionsWithBlankTitles.description: Visually hides all dimensions that do not have a title, and would otherwise have the title '(blank)', regardless of whether the dimension contains values

HierarchyName.name: hierarchyName
HierarchyName.description: The parent name of your hierarchy (change is only visual, does not affect writeback)

ShowHierarchy.name: showHierarchies
ShowHierarchy.description: Shows the hierarchy level on the row headers

CellBackgroundOpacity.name: gridOpacity
CellBackgroundOpacity.description: Determines the background opacity of all cells in the grid from a scale of 0% - 100%

DynamicHeaderPosition.name: dynamicHeaderPosition
DynamicHeaderPosition.description: Determines the placement of the dynamic header text relative to the existing label

IndentationString.name: rowHeaderIndentationSymbol
IndentationString.description: String values used for row header indentation

MeasureType.name: measureType
MeasureType.description: Decides the type of the chosen measure

TrueStateWritebackValue.name: booleanTrueValue
TrueStateWritebackValue.description: The value to use when a boolean measure is true.

FalseStateWritebackValue.name: booleanFalseValue
FalseStateWritebackValue.description: The value to use when a boolean measure is false.

ShowMeasureInRow.name: showMeasureInRow
ShowMeasureInRow.description: Moves measure dimensions from columns to rows

ShowEmptyValues.name: showEmptyValues
ShowEmptyValues.description: Determines visibility of dimensions that only have blank values. Note, hidden dimensions are still processed by accoPLANNING. If you encounter slow start-up times with this setting turned off, turn it on and verify the data given by your measures

ApplyNonWriteableStylesToLabels.name: applyToLabels
ApplyNonWriteableStylesToLabels.description: Applies the color values from the non-writeable settings to the measure labels

ApplyWriteableStylesToLabels.name: applySecondaryToLabels
ApplyWriteableStylesToLabels.description: Applies the color values from the writeable settings to the measure labels

Aggregation.name: aggregation
Aggregation.description: The aggregation method used for subtotals and grand totals (no effect if both are disabled)

AggregationWeight.name: aggregationWeight
AggregationWeight.description: The measure used as weight in the calculation of weighted averages aggregation method

ShowBlankValuesAs.name: nullValue
ShowBlankValuesAs.description: Displays the given value within all cells with null values

CurrencySymbol.name: currencySymbol
CurrencySymbol.description: Prepends a symbol to every cell, primarily used for currencies

PrependCurrencySymbol.name: currencySymbolPrepend
PrependCurrencySymbol.description: If disabled, currency symbol is appended to the value

UseDataModelFormatting.name: useDataModelFormatting
UseDataModelFormatting.description: uses data model formatting, ignoring custom values

NonWriteableTextColor.name: fontColorPrimary
NonWriteableTextColor.description: Text color on cells that are ineligible for editing

NonWriteableBackgroundColor.name: backColorPrimary
NonWriteableBackgroundColor.description: Fill color on cells that are ineligible for editing

WriteableTextColor.name: fontColorSecondary
WriteableTextColor.description: Text color on cells that can be edited

WriteableBackgroundColor.name: backColorSecondary
WriteableBackgroundColor.description: Fill color on cells that can be edited

MenuItemSeparator.name: dropdownItemSeparator
MenuItemSeparator.description: The symbol that separates dropdown options '100|200|500'

AllowCustomValues.name: dropdownAllowCustomInputs
AllowCustomValues.displayName: Allow custom values in cells w/ dropdown
AllowCustomValues.description: Allows inputs in cells outside the dropdown choices

EnableKeyValuePairs.name: enableDropdownKV
EnableKeyValuePairs.description: Allows dropdown choices to have a value displayed to the user and a key that is used on submission. E.g. for products and Ids

KeyValueSeparator.name: dropdownKVSeparator
KeyValueSeparator.description: The symbol that separates keys and values within dropdown choices '10;The Phantom Dropdown|20;Attack of the Dropdown|30;Revenge of the Dropdown'

ShowDisplayValueInCells.name: dropdownShowDisplayValue
ShowDisplayValueInCells.displayName: Show the display value in cells
ShowDisplayValueInCells.description: Shows the display value in cells while submitting the key

CommentDelimiter.name: commentDelimiter
CommentDelimiter.description: The symbol to delimit single strings into distinct comments, 'A New Comment|The Comment Strikes Back|Return of the Comment'

MeasureToDisplayOn.name: commentApplyTo
MeasureToDisplayOn.description: Which measure to show comment flags or metadata from the comment field on, and to write back to

CommentType.name: commentType
CommentType.description: Determines whether the comment field is a displayed writeback value, a non-displayed writeback value, or metadata

EnableSplashing.name: enableSplashing
EnableSplashing.description: Splashing allows for inputting values over a range of cells with a given distribution method or measures

EnableInputsOnParentCells.name: enableParentLevelEntry
EnableInputsOnParentCells.description: Enables value inputs on aggregation cells. Output affects all cells within the parent's lineage.

DefaultDistributionMethod.name: defaultSplashing
DefaultDistributionMethod.description: Uses the given behavior when conditions for splashing are met

DefaultSplashingMeasure.name: defaultMeasure
DefaultSplashingMeasure.description: Uses the given behavior when conditions for splashing are met

DefaultRoundingMethod.name: defaultRounding
DefaultRoundingMethod.description: Uses the given rounding method for splashing if one is chosen.

CellLockMode.name: lockMode
CellLockMode.description: OR locks if any measure is locked. AND locks only if all measures are locked.

CommentsOnLockedCells.name: commentsOnLockedCells
CommentsOnLockedCells.description: Allow user to make comments on locked cells

MeasureToLockOn.name: lockCellApplyTo
MeasureToLockOn.description: Which measure should show this lock cell indicator

AllowUserExporting.name: allowUserExporting
AllowUserExporting.description: Allow user exporting, Enables the exporting button when not in editing mode (aka Read view)

AllowAdvancedOptionsInReadMode.name: allowAdvancedOptions
AllowAdvancedOptionsInReadMode.displayName: Allow access to adv. options in read mode
AllowAdvancedOptionsInReadMode.description: Advanced options allow users to create custom dimensions, measures, adjust customization and more. By default this is only accessible in Advanced Edit. Any changes the user makes in advanced edit can only be persisted in edit mode in the report

AllowUserToCommentInReadMode.name: allowUserComment
AllowUserToCommentInReadMode.displayName: Allow user to comment in read mode
AllowUserToCommentInReadMode.description: Allows the user to comment in reading mode. When disabled allows users to read comments but not write new ones. Works well in conjunction with Reporting Mode.

ReportingMode.name: reportingMode
ReportingMode.description: Reporting mode disables the selector, editing capability & writeback save functions.

LatestSavedVersion.name: latestSavedVersion
LatestSavedVersion.displayName: Latest accoPLANNING version used on this instance
